title: Post-transplant Thrombotic Microangiopathy: Evaluation of Outcomes at the Bologna Kidney Transplant Centre
official: Post-transplant Thrombotic Microangiopathy: Evaluation of Outcomes at the Bologna Kidney Transplant Centre
summary: It is a retrospective-prospective, single-centre, non-pharmacological, retrospective tissue study carried out for scientific and health protection purposes. It involves the systematic collection of clinical information from patients diagnosed with PT-TMA
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Living kidney transplant recipient, brain death cadaver donor, cardiac death cadaver donor, single kidney transplant, double kidney transplant, combined kidney transplant
* Acquisition of Informed Consent to participate in the study and to process personal, special and genetic data

Exclusion Criteria:
